thresholdMinutes.description: The threshold the report was computed with (the request's, or 120).

trailers.description: Trailers of this kind that departed in the window.

exceeding.description: Of those, the ones whose dwell exceeded thresholdMinutes.

share.description: exceeding / trailers, 0..1; null when there were no trailers.

excessMinutes.description: Sum of (dwell - thresholdMinutes) over the exceeding trailers. Exposure, not a billed amount.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an unknown field, a NUL byte, a missing or invalid Idempotency-Key, or an invalid path or query parameter.
